cohort: 3619 women with singleton pregnancies, from the population-based FinnBrain Birth Cohort Study
finding: Maternal anxiety symptoms, measured using PRAQ-R2, FOC, and SCL-90, were associated with an increased likelihood of elective cesarean section and epidural analgesia use, and longer second stage of labor.
mod_finding: Maternal anxiety symptoms (measured using PRAQ-R2, FOC, and SCL-90) were associated with an increased likelihood of elective cesarean section but not with instrumental delivery or emergency cesarean section.
